tasks.commitBody:
The time-format preference shipped in #207 now applies to displayed
times as well as pickers (Mihkel: the preference applies globally).
One shared formatter in the preference module — tallinnHHMM for the
Tallinn wall-clock HH:MM and formatTime for the 24h/AM-PM rendering —
is consumed by the three surfaces that print a clock time: agenda
rows, the event detail time and range, and the event-created toast.
With the preference unset or 24h the output is unchanged; in AM/PM
mode 19:00 reads 7:00 PM and ranges render both ends explicitly.
Stored and submitted values and all date rendering are untouched. A
source-scanning spec keeps 24h time rendering from reappearing outside
the formatter.

Season-panel series rows, lending and invite surfaces render no clock
time today, so those done-when items are not applicable.

Closes #220
